test_title: SSC Steno 2022 Official Paper (Held On: 18 Nov 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Select the option that expresses the given sentence in active voice.

A farewell party for me has been organised by my office colleagues.

options.text: My office colleagues are going to organise a farewell party for me.
My office colleagues have organised a farewell party for me.
My office colleagues are organising a farewell party for me.
A farewell party for me is about to be organised by my office colleagues.

solution:
The correct answer is "**My office colleagues have organised a farewell party for me.**"

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Active voice sentences have the subject performing the action while passive voice sentences have the subject receiving the action.
 
• To convert a passive sentence to active, we need to make the subject the doer of the action.
 
• In this sentence, the subject is "a farewell party for me" and the action is "has been organised by my office colleagues".
 
• **To make it active, we need to make "my office colleagues" the subject and "organised" the action verb.**
 
• Therefore, the active sentence is "My office colleagues have organised a farewell party for me."

Hence, **the correct answer is option 2**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__

 
• Option 1 (My office colleagues are going to organise a farewell party for me) is in the future tense and does not reflect the given sentence in active voice.
 
• Option 3 (My office colleagues are organising a farewell party for me) is in the present continuous tense and does not reflect the given sentence in active voice.
 
• Option 4 (A farewell party for me is about to be organised by my office colleagues) is in the passive voice, but the tense has been changed to future continuous.
